name: vauly
description: A self-hosted, end-to-end encrypted password manager for small teams.

scripts.env:generate: varlock codegen --path ./apps/web/ && varlock codegen --path ./apps/server/ && varlock codegen --path ./packages/db/
scripts.postinstall: varlock codegen --path ./apps/web/ && varlock codegen --path ./apps/server/ && varlock codegen --path ./packages/db/
scripts.test: bun test --cwd packages/crypto && bun test --cwd packages/db && bun test --cwd packages/api && bun test --cwd apps/cli && bun test --cwd apps/web && bun test --cwd apps/extension && bun test --cwd packages/ui

SETUP_CODE.description: A code only you know, so nobody else can claim your vauly before you do. Once it's deployed, open `/setup?code=` followed by this code on your vauly's address to create the workspace. Leave it empty and whoever opens your vauly first becomes its owner.
